## Scope and completion evidence
Select one bounded pathway in each language; enumerate objectives and prerequisites, reproduce code on named machines/tool versions, trace generated artifacts to execution, design independent-transfer and troubleshooting tasks. Pilot with actual learners where possible; do not claim educational validation from AI review. Record friction and revise the lesson contract.

## Done when
- Results and source/version/environment identities are recorded, with passed/failed/skipped/unknown distinguished.
- Findings are filed as specific follow-up issues or linked to existing ones; no duplicate implementation plan.
- Reviewed findings, limits and next bounded step are linked from this issue.

Maintain existing product architecture and avoid broad rewrites.
title: [Education] Pilot Spectrum BASIC and assembly pathways with learner-evidence gates
